newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina said sold 1.3-1.5 mln T 1996/97 maize.
newsitem.headline: Argentina said sold 1.3-1.5 mln T 1996/97 maize.

text.p: Argentine exporters have run up forward sales of 1.3 million-1.5 million tonnes of 1996/97 maize, with South Korean buyers taking the bulk, a grain export analyst said Tuesday.
He said South Korea was committed to buying around one million tonnes, while the rest of sales were to the Philippines, Indonesia and Taiwan.
Sales of 1996/97 wheat have probably reached about 3.5 million tonnes, he said. Brazil has been the biggest buyer with orders for around one million tonnes, he said.

He said that recent sales have included between 50,000 and 100,000 tonnes placed with former Soviet republics and 100,000 tonnes with Bulgaria. Peru has also bought another 25,000 tonnes to take its total to around 185,000 tonnes.
The analyst said that sales of 1996/97 soybeans, sunflower seed and sorghum seemed minimal so far.

Argentina's Agricultural Secretariat estimated 1996/97 wheat production at 14.9 million tonnes in its last crop report, released last Thursday dated November 1. Wheat output would be up from 9.2 million tonnes last season.

The Secretariat said maize output should climb to 13.0 million tonnes from 10.5 million tonnes. Soybean output should remain roughly the same at 12.4 million tonnes, and sunflower seed production should slip to 5.3 million tonnes from 5.6 million tonnes.
